Hi Jorge / Maya —

Great context, thank you. I've sketched an initial, pragmatic plan below so our kickoff call is execution-oriented. Please treat this as our onboarding "cost & perf playbook" draft.

1) Discovery (Day 0–3)
- Share representative payloads and 200–300 sample requests covering short (10–40 tokens), medium (200–600), and long (1k–2k) context flows.
- Share current traffic profile (tokens/month, typical concurrency, peak qps).
- Provide any quality thresholds (BLEU/embedding-sim/ops evaluation) or prompt tests we should preserve.

2) Baseline run (Day 3–6) — owner: Dev
- Dev will run a baseline on Redwood hosted dev cluster using your sample payloads and produce acme_initial_benchmark.csv with: p50/p95/p99 latencies, tokens/sec, GPU memory, and cost per 1k tokens estimates.
- Baseline config: no batching, quantization: float16, routing to stable 13B model.

3) Optimization sweep (Day 7–14) — owners: Dev + Marissa
- Batching: test dynamic batching with max_batch_size {4,8,16} and bounded latency targets. Measure tradeoffs for short vs long prompts.
- Caching: enable prefix/KV caching for session-based assistant flows; test TTLs at 5m and 30m for repeated context.
- Quantization profiles: try Q4_0 and Q5_0 (int8) profiles on candidate models; evaluate quality delta vs float16 baseline using your test prompts.
- Routing policy: propose primary model = 13B quantized (cost-efficient), fallback = 7B unquantized for tight latency paths or constrained cost windows; also propose region routing to avoid cross-region egress.

4) Cost modeling and SLOs (Day 10–16)
- We'll produce a short model-card style doc that shows per-token cost, recommended quantization per workload, and expected monthly bill at current and optimized configs.
- Suggested guardrail: set automatic fallback when avg latency > 150ms or cost per 1k tokens exceeds agreed threshold.

5) Implementation & Handover (Day 14–21)
- Provide a small config bundle (attachment: rwi_batching_recommendation.yaml) with suggested runtime flags and autoscale settings for Dedicated/Hosted.
- Schedule a 1-hour implementation session with your infra team to apply the configs and validate in staging.

Action items before kickoff call:
- Jorge/Maya: upload sample request set (200–300) to the shared Drive link below.
- Marissa: set a kickoff invite for Wed 3/4 10am PT.
- Dev: prepare baseline runbook and initial CSV template.

Attachments: rwi_batching_recommendation.yaml (stub, runtime flags + example batch sizes)
Related link: https://drive.redwood.company/shared/onboarding-acme

We will keep the first optimization sweep narrow — start with batching + Q4_0 quantization on the 13B candidate and measure. If quality degradation is >5% on your test set we will fall back to float16 for that route.

If this plan looks good I will finalize the kickoff invite and assign owners in HubSpot.
